results.question: Is 'Read more' acceptable link text?
results.answer_preview:
No. On its own, "Read more" isn't acceptable link text. The component conventions say link text must describe the destination, so "Click here" and "Read more" on their own are not allowed [1].

results.question: What's our minimum color contrast for body text?
results.answer_preview: Your minimum color contrast for body text is 4.5:1 [1].
